0022600107.text: Atlanta, 1-0 and first in the Southeast, hosts Houston, also 1-0 and first in the Southwest, in the Hawks' third game of the 2026-27 season. Atlanta will be without Henri Veesaar, who is out with a knee injury, and Mouhamed Gueye, who is out with a fractured foot. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Houston beat Atlanta 117-95 in their last meeting in Houston on March 20, 2026, after sweeping the 2025-26 season series 2-0.
